blind.B1: No. GSE146336 is 22 male soleus RNA-seq samples, WT vs TRa1 HSACre x T3 vs vehicle (S2.5, S2.6, S3.3.p1, FIG3). Exercise (treadmill, 6-week wheel running; S2.4, S3.1.p1) was phenotyping in separate unsequenced cohorts. No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor; packet A found no exercise words in any column.
blind.B2: S3.3.p1/FIG3A: TRa-HSACre vs WT SOL under vehicle (788 DEGs); FIG3B: WT-T3 vs HSACre-T3 (GO enrichment). FIG3 n: vehicle WT/KO 5-6/4-6, T3 WT/KO 5-6/7. GEO has 11 WT/11 KO, 9 vehicle/13 T3.
blind.B3: Not evidently. Each animal gives one soleus. Packet A candidate keys link 0/22 samples; no repeated-measures indication.
blind.B4: One model: edgeR quasi-likelihood, ~0 + group with group = genotype x treatment, contrasts per the edgeR manual (S2.6.p1). Joint fit.
blind.B5: S2.11.p1: 'Selection of differentially expressed genes and gene ontology enrichments were done based on false discovery adjusted P-values.' No cutoff or fold-change rule stated for DEGs (P < .05 is the general significance rule). Count: 788 DEGs, KO vs WT vehicle (S3.3.p1).

checks.evidence: S2.4, S3.1.p1 vs S2.5/S3.3.p1; no exercise words in metadata; refusal matches B1.
Case refused; no contrast run. GEO n (9/13) vs FIG3 n recorded as a discrepancy.
One soleus per animal; packet A keys link 0/22. Refusal does not rest on a missing animal ID.
Paper fit is joint edgeR QL ~0+group (S2.6.p1); recorded in paper_method. Nothing run.
Not evaluated; single sex, single tissue.
Integer featureCounts matrix, 55,487 x 22, integer_fraction 1.0; matches edgeR input in S2.6.p1.
FDR transcribed from S2.11.p1; cutoff 0.05 is labelled as assumed from the general P<.05 rule. Paper states no explicit DEG cutoff or fold change.
HANDBACK reports 'none run' and cites 788 only as the paper's KO vs WT vehicle count; makes no claim of agreement.

'No exercise arm in sequenced samples' is true and was established from the paper (S2.4, S3.1.p1, S3.3.p1) and the metadata. Cosmetic: suitability.md says failed sample_size (0/0 comparisons), which does not match the real reason; the case records this under Tool problems.

human_items: Policy question only: if T3-by-genotype series were ever to count as exercise-adjacent, this case would need reopening. Under the skill's current rules it does not.
summary: 该系列是 T3/载体 × 肌肉 TRα1 突变的比目鱼肌 RNA-seq，运动(跑台、转轮)只是未测序队列的表型指标，因此以“无运动对比”拒绝分析是正确的。阈值转录(FDR，0.05 为假定)与论文一致，HANDBACK 没有夸大。仅有一个次要问题：suitability 报告写 sample_size 失败，与真实拒绝原因不符，案例已自行记录。
